scope: Current eight manifest drafts only. Language vs location vs maker connection vs historic award nomenclature. No new biographies or definitive linguistic/political taxonomy.
method: Reused complete prior reading, reread relevant current passages and verified all eight SHA256 hashes unchanged since claims audit. Read current loop and combined contributor shortlist; no external browsing needed because no unresolved new factual assertion identified.

optional_clarity.proposed_sentence: This selection follows Odia-language films alongside Sambalpuri cinema and the work of artists with documented connections to Odisha.
optional_clarity.reason: Explains umbrella scope without absorbing distinct languages or ranking cultural belonging. Existing body already makes these distinctions.

editorial_guardrails: Use each work’s named-source language description; never infer language from director birthplace, filming location, surname or award geography.
Retain Sambalpuri as named in sources; do not add dialect/language hierarchy or political identity assertions.
Historic Oriya and Odiya award labels can be reproduced accurately while modern prose uses Odia; these spellings are not separate newly inferred language categories.
A story setting is not proof of filming location, and a creator connection is not a community mandate.
The contributor shortlist is not an extension of the current article evidence: new works require separate language/credit verification.
remaining_limits: No full-film audio verification or exhaustive multilingual-dialogue inventory.
Source-based labels are not claims to settle contested linguistic classification.
Current source-access and festival focus still shape regional coverage; this audit does not make the selection representative of all Odisha cinema.
coverage_limits: Period and craft fields describe these essays, not complete careers or filmographies.
WesternOdisha, coastal centres and Malkangiri appear in different ways; named locations do not amount to balanced district coverage.
Language variety beyond named works, exhibition/distribution networks, other technical workers and audiences remain incompletely represented.
Festival/award and digitally accessible records disproportionately determine current examples.
